title: Simulation and maximum likelihood estimation for a stochastic convection-diffusion equation: Fortran spectral Galerkin implementation
description: Fortran implementation of a spectral Galerkin discretization of a stochastic convection-diffusion equation with additive noise, including Euler-Maruyama simulation, maximum likelihood estimation of the diffusion and convection coefficients, Monte Carlo studies, and the scripts that reproduce the figures of the article Simulation and maximum likelihood estimation for a stochastic convection-diffusion equation (submitted to Communications in Nonlinear Science and Numerical Simulation).
